column1: # The given name SIXTA is worth noting: Candido Juanico's second wife was SIXTA LENGUAS GONZALEZ.
# The family is naming children after both sides of it, which is what a real household does.
# *** WHO JOSE PEDRO MASSERA WAS. ***
# The groom of 1913 is JOSE PEDRO MASSERA (1866-1942), professor of philosophy at the Universidad de
# la Republica in Montevideo from 1887 to 1927 and a Colorado senator from 1927. The age on the act -
# forty-six in June 1913 - fits his birth year exactly. Independent sources (Encyclopedia.com;
# MacTutor; the Diccionario Biografico de las Izquierdas Latinoamericanas) give his wife as
# "Ema Lerena Joanico" and their son as JOSE LUIS MASSERA (1915-2002), the mathematician - Uruguay's
# most celebrated, and a political prisoner of the dictatorship.
# So the one Lerena baptised at Rosario in a hundred and seventy years has a sister who married into
# that family. It is recorded because it is true and because it was reached from an act read here,
# not because it bears on the central question.
# *** IT DOES NOT BEAR ON THE CENTRAL QUESTION. *** Nothing connects this household to Pablo Armando
# Lerena or to Juan Carlos. Said plainly so that a striking name does not do the work of evidence.
Jose Julio
